about: A one-dimensional wave-propagation study solved with the first-order upwind (backward) differencing scheme, accurate to first order in time and space, with solutions plotted at several time levels.

features.title: First-order upwind scheme
features.body: Backward differencing, first-order accurate in both time and space: order of accuracy [Δt, Δx].

features.title: Stable for C ≤ 1
features.body: The scheme stays stable as long as the Courant number is at most 1.

features.title: Fixed, documented setup
features.body: Δx = 0.01 with u = 0.09 and Δt = 0.01, so the run is easy to reproduce.

features.title: Plotted with Gnuplot
features.body: Velocity profiles at t = 1, 5 and 10 s show how the wave travels and smears.

extra_stats: grid spacing used in the study
